home_url.description: wp home_url(), used as the challenge callback target

locales.description: distinct locales in use on the site (site_locale + user locales + multilingual-plugin locales)

install_pub.description: base64 Ed25519 public key of the per-install keypair generated on activation, in either of two forms: the raw 32-byte key, or its 44-byte SubjectPublicKeyInfo DER encoding (prefix 302a300506032b6570032100 + the same 32 raw bytes). The server normalises either form to the raw 32 bytes before storing it. The matching private key signs the proof returned by GET /wp-json/babilim/v1/challenge and submitted to POST /v1/sites/{id}/verify -- see docs/api/v1.md section 5 for the exact signed-message format. Anything else is rejected with 422 unprocessable.
